advisory_evidence: GENERATED_GRADE: no assay values; Riazi 1989 TBP distribution on the shared crude_pc01..12 cuts, shape first (E10): TBP, C1-C5 and 565 C+ meet the specification
API_FROM_CUTS: density and API are what the shared cuts give; the cuts carry the Watson K (11.6-12.0) of the Tia Juana Light characterisation
LIGHT_END_SPLIT: the C1-C5 split by mass is an assumption (CRUDE_GRADES_REVIEW 3.1); its methane makes the grade apply only to packages holding Methane
SULFUR_METADATA: sulfur is a specification for display only; no sulfur species are carried
TRANSPORT: cut liquid viscosity Twu 1985 + ASTM D341 (twu-1985-d341-r1); liquid-mixture pair coefficient fitted to ECCC whole crudes (OGL-Canada)

specification.open_references: ECCC Alberta Sweet Mixed Blend #5 (512.5, API 35.7), Bakken (1969.1, API 40.3 measured)

method.formula: x(T) = 1 - exp(-(B/A) ((T - T0)/T0)^B), mass fraction of the C6+ part boiling below T
method.cut_bin_rule: each crude_pc cut takes the mass between the midpoints of its NBP and its neighbours' NBPs; crude_pc12 open above (null)

source_whole_crude.note: density at 15 C by ideal volume additivity of the cuts' standard densities (API MPMS 11.1 crude expansion from 60 F); sulfur is the specification, metadata only
